{{Top|leg}}
[[Galactic Solutions Industries]] maintained an '''Metallurgical Division''' that researched and developed metals for use in GSI products. One of their projects was the procurement of samples of the metal used in the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[isotope-5 droid]]s so that they could implement it in GSI's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and weapons.
